candidates.change_summary: Remove the update to acc.unlockTime so it retains its previous value after Put.
Set acc.unlockTime to _unlockTime unconditionally, ignoring block.timestamp.
Remove the entire nonReentrant modifier logic, making the function permanently callable without reentrancy guard.
Remove the subtraction of _am from acc.balance, so the balance is not reduced after successful transfer.
Remove the require check, allowing reentrant calls that could alter behavior during execution.
Remove the final `locked_ = false;` statement, permanently locking the contract after first use of nonReentrant_ modifier.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Collect, allowing reentrant calls during the external call.
Change the balance requirement from acc.balance >= _am to acc.balance > _am so collecting the full balance reverts.
Move the balance subtraction state update to after the external call, changing what a reentrant callee observes.
Require the external call to fail by changing if (_s) to if (!_s), so the balance is subtracted only when the call fails.
Delete the require(!locked_) precondition in nonReentrant_, allowing previously reentrant calls to proceed instead of reverting.
Move the state update `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` from after the external call to before it, so the balance is decreased before reentrancy can occur.
Change the external call receiver from msg.sender to tx.origin, so the call target differs and balance state after Collect can differ at arbitrary keys.
Change the condition from `acc.balance>=_am` to `acc.balance<=_am`, allowing Collect to underflow or behave differently and leaving Acc state observably different.
Change the unlockTime condition from `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp<acc.unlockTime`, allowing withdrawal at different times and leaving Acc state observably different.
Change the balance subtraction from `acc.balance - _am` to `acc.balance + _am` via add_uint256, so Collect increases the stored balance and Acc differs.
Remove the state update inside the successful external call, so Collect no longer decreases the recorded balance and Acc remains unchanged.
